keyEvents.text: Goal! Troyes 0, Le Havre 1. Josh Maja (Le Havre) right footed shot from outside the box to the centre of the goal.
Goal! Troyes 1, Le Havre 1. Antoine Mille (Troyes) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Kandet Diawara.
Josh Maja (Le Havre) is shown the yellow card.
Junior Mwanga (Le Havre) is shown the yellow card.
Dermane Karim (Troyes) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Troyes 1, Le Havre 1.
Substitution, Troyes. Lucas Maronnier replaces Yvann Titi.
Second Half begins Troyes 1, Le Havre 1.
Ismaël Boura (Troyes) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Ayumu Seko (Le Havre).
Delay in match because of an injury Hillel Konaté (Troyes).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Le Havre. Hakim Dongopandji replaces Rayan Fofana.
Substitution, Le Havre. Djibril Ouziad replaces Kaito Mizuta.
Goal! Troyes 2, Le Havre 1. Antoine Mille (Troyes) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Anis Ouzenadji.
Ahmed Touba (Le Havre) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Merwan Ifnaoui (Troyes).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Troyes. Renaud Ripart replaces Jérémy Le Douaron.
Substitution, Troyes. Hugo Picard replaces Merwan Ifnaoui because of an injury.
Substitution, Le Havre. Ismaïl Bouneb replaces Simon Ebonog.
Substitution, Troyes. Iron Gomis replaces Mouhamed Diop.
Substitution, Le Havre. Bocar Wade replaces Vincent Sasso.
Substitution, Le Havre. Mbwana Samatta replaces Josh Maja.
Delay in match because of an injury Lucas Maronnier (Troyes).
Delay in match (Le Havre). VAR checking.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Enzo Koffi (Le Havre) is shown the red card.
Substitution, Troyes. Timothé Nkada replaces Kandet Diawara.
Goal! Troyes 3, Le Havre 1. Renaud Ripart (Troyes) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the centre of the goal.
